name: Huginn · Recurrent-depth
tagline: Reinject the input. Sample depth. Truncate the gradient.
description: Each recursion reads both the evolving latent state and a fixed input representation. Training samples recurrent depth and backpropagates through the final recursions; earlier forward-only recursions still count toward training cost.
paperTitle: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach
mechanism: 3 prelude + 8 core blocks × 1–4 sampled recursions + 3 coda; 3 recursions at evaluation
Keyed random sampling makes row-level initial noise and update-level depth reproducible
Concatenated input injection, sandwich RMSNorm and backpropagation through the final 2 recursions
limitations: A common-backbone adaptation. The registered truncated distribution averages 2.6503467 recursions, not its mean parameter of 3.
